## Exercises (sample)

1. On shared associations (classic many-to-many): deleting one parent must not delete shared children.
2. `LAZY`.
3. One query loads parents; looping associations fires about one extra query per parent (or per miss).
4. EntityGraph is per use case; global EAGER loads data even when unused and can still surprise you with SQL shape.

## Self-check

1. **No.** Ownership is `mappedBy` / `@JoinColumn`. Cascade only propagates operations.
2. **False.** It loads when first needed (and the provider supports it).
3. `@EntityGraph`.
4. Turn on SQL logging and watch repeated SELECTs inside a loop.
